title: Police Commission's own budget request
summary: In 2024 the Police Commission voted to have a commissioner draft its budget letter, asking $351,500 for its own budget. In October 2026 it voted 7-0 to create a budget working group to prepare the commission's budget and review the department's.

timeline.text: A commissioner said the commission is asking for $351,500 for its own budget.
The commission voted to let a commissioner draft its budget letter for the chair to sign.
Resuming in-person Civil Service Commission meetings: The chair set April 2025 as a tentative date to resume in-person meetings, without a vote.
